t is impossible to exaggerate the importance of this,probably the most famous series of letters in the world. We may,however, point out that it is unique in a double sense, for not only are these the only love letters which have passed between two greatpoets, but also they are the only letters which passed between Browning and his wife,for after their marriage they were never separated for a day.
